name: Hajimete no Otsukai ~first adventure of little witch~
original_name: はじめてのおつかい ～first adventure of little witch～
source:
Main character is a black cat Georges who lives with a witch in the forest house. One day master brought a little human girl Apple. 100 years passed and master decided that Apple should see the world. The cat was sent with her to bodyguard and counsel her. And so they set off.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是黑猫乔治，与一名女巫住在森林小屋。某天，主人带来一个名叫苹果的人类小女孩。100年过去，主人决定让苹果去看看世界，并派黑猫随行保护和指引她。于是，他们出发了。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
